statements.headline: Hazardous Weather Outlook
statements.summary: Today and tonight. A few waves of heavy rainfall is expected to pass through the region today and into tonight. Some storms will produce heavy rainfall that will lead to flooding through the day and into tonight.

details.label: Today's Hazards
details.text: Today and tonight. A few waves of heavy rainfall is expected to pass through the region today and into tonight. Some storms will produce heavy rainfall that will lead to flooding through the day and into tonight.

details.label: Extended Outlook
details.text: Monday through Saturday. Rounds of rain expected through mid-week next week. Longer duration higher amounts could lead to river rises and areal flooding.
